name: Pulled Over
source:
You're cruising down a deserted highway when flashing lights appear in your rearview mirror. But these aren't your average patrol officers. They're gorgeous. Intense. And very interested in what you've got going on under the hood.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4600940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当你在一条荒芜的高速公路上行驶时，后视镜中出现了闪烁的灯光。但这些不是普通的巡逻人员。他们很漂亮。激烈的。并且对你在幕后发生的事情非常感兴趣。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4600940/]Steam[/url]]
